title: restic.commit.v1
description: One restic commit: an attempt to put a snapshot into a repository, whether it succeeded or failed.  method=backup reads a file system into the repository (restic backup); method=copy transfers existing snapshots from another repository (restic copy).  The destination may be local or remote, and a backup may go straight to a remote repository.  Subject: the stream whose latest outcome matters, e.g. 'run' (the main backup), 'run/NAME' (an extra tree) or 'push' (the transfer to the remote repository).  Field names and units of the statistics are restic's own (restic backup --json, summary message); started, ended and duration are restic's when it reports them, else the emitter's measurements.  For a copy, total_files_processed and total_bytes_processed are summed over the snapshots copied.  Repository URLs must not carry passwords.

result.description: ok: committed.  partial: the snapshot was made but some source files could not be read (restic exit 3).  fail: nothing was committed.

method.description: backup: from a file system.  copy: from another repository.

repository.description: Destination repository, as restic names it (path or URL), with any password removed.

location.description: local: a path on this host.  remote: any other backend (sftp:, rest:, s3:, ...).

source_repository.description: method=copy: the repository the snapshots came from.

paths.description: method=backup: the file system paths backed up.

snapshot_id.description: method=backup: the new snapshot (restic reports the full id).

snapshots_copied.description: method=copy: how many snapshots were transferred; 0 when the destination was already up to date.

snapshots.description: method=copy: one entry per snapshot transferred.

id.description: Id of the new snapshot in the destination.

source_id.description: Id of the snapshot it was copied from.

data_added.description: Bytes added to the repository, before compression.

data_added_packed.description: Bytes added to the repository as stored (compressed).

total_bytes_processed.description: Size of everything the snapshot covers, not only what was new.

exit_code.description: restic's exit status: 0 ok, 3 incomplete backup, 10 no repository, 11 locked, 12 wrong password, ...

error.description: What went wrong, in restic's words.  Required unless result is ok.

error_count.description: Number of source items restic could not read.
